args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for money rounding per FIN-212

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that 2.675 rounds to 2.68 and 2.665 rounds to 2.66.

CI: passed (ci-0001)
